responsibility: Implements common expression-node behavior that is not the main semantic pass. This file provides helpers for `this` availability and `need this` checks, tuple and `alias this` tuple expansion, lvalue/modifiability and boolean conversions for selected expressions, late resolution of built-in `__FILE__`/`__LINE__`/`__MODULE__`/`__FUNCTION__` defaults, destructor-side-effect collection for conditionals, and evaluation-order rewrites such as associative-array assignment sequencing.
same_name_distinction: Supplies shared expression-side algorithms and helper semantics—such as `hasThis`, tuple and `alias this` expansion, builtin location-string resolution, conditional destructor handling, and AA assignment reordering—whereas `expression.h` defines the expression AST hierarchy and broad expression service interfaces.
